verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog documents a 'Write with Agent' button that reviews changes made since the last update, checks the linked Slack channel, and writes an update draft for you to refine, which is exactly AI-drafted status updates from recent activity. Shared skills for 'drafting updates' and Loops that can update plans and post Slack summaries add to this. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that the feature covers both project and initiative updates (the snippet doesn't name the surface), in-depth first-party docs beyond changelog snippets, independent or hands-on corroboration.
